name: finance_api_static_validation_real_cases_20260825
scope: Existing model-authored finance API strings plus ordinary business extensions; no adversarial synthetic method names.

cases.user_query: 查询贵州茅台的股票代码、所属行业和上市日期。
cases.request: r1 = stock.basic_info(filter = "name = '贵州茅台'", limit = 1) -> code, name, industry, listed_date

cases.user_query: 筛选所属行业包含银行的股票，返回代码、名称和上市日期。
cases.request: r1 = stock.basic_info(filter = "industry like %银行%", order = "code asc", limit = 50) -> code, name, industry, listed_date

cases.user_query: 贵州茅台当前最新价、涨跌幅和成交额是多少？
cases.request: r1 = stock.quote(filter = "code = 600519.SH", limit = 1, mode = 2) -> code, name, tradedate, snapshot_time, close, pct, preclose, amount, high, low

cases.user_query: 查询贵州茅台2026年8月4日的日行情。
cases.request: r1 = stock.quote(filter = "code = 600519.SH and tradedate = 2026-08-04", limit = 1, mode = 0) -> code, name, tradedate, close, pct, amount, volumn, high, low, open

cases.user_query: 查询宁德时代最近10个交易日的收盘价和涨跌幅。
cases.request: r1 = stock.quote(filter = "code = 300750.SZ", order = "tradedate desc", limit = 10, mode = 0) -> code, name, tradedate, close, pct

cases.user_query: 近20个交易日平均振幅最高的20只股票有哪些？
cases.request: r1 = stock.quote.kd_amplitude_avg(k = 20, filter = "all", order = "value desc", limit = 20, mode = 0) -> code, name, value as avg_amplitude_20d

cases.user_query: 查询贵州茅台最新交易日的主力净额、主力净占比和大单净额。
cases.request: r1 = stock.moneyflow(filter = "code = 600519.SH", order = "tradedate desc", limit = 1) -> code, name, tradedate, main_net, main_ratio, large_net, large_ratio

cases.user_query: 查询近5个交易日主力净流入合计最高的前10只股票。
cases.request: r1 = stock.moneyflow.kd_main_net_sum(k = 5, order = "value desc", limit = 10, realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as main_net_5d_sum

cases.user_query: 沪深300指数的代码和名称是什么？
cases.request: r1 = index.basic_info(filter = "code = 000300.SH", limit = 1) -> code, name

cases.user_query: 过去20个交易日跌幅最大的前10只指数有哪些？
cases.request: r1 = index.quote.kd_pct_sum(k = 20, order = "value asc", limit = 10, realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as pct_20d

cases.user_query: 半导体行业当前有哪些成分股？
cases.request: r1 = industry.constitution(filter = "industry_name = 半导体", order = "stock_code asc", limit = -1) -> industry_code, industry_name, stock_code, stock_name

cases.user_query: 成分股数量最多的申万三级行业前20名。
cases.request: r1 = industry.constitution.agg(filter = "level = 3", agg = count(stock.quote.code), group_by = "level3_industry_name", order = "count_code desc", limit = 20) -> level3_industry_name, count_code

cases.user_query: 查询宁德时代所在行业的全部成分股。
cases.request: r2 = industry.constitution(filter = "industry_name = r1.industry", order = "stock_code asc", limit = -1) -> industry_code, industry_name, stock_code, stock_name

cases.user_query: 查询宁德时代所在行业的全部成分股。
cases.request: r2 = industry.constitution(filter = "industry_name in r1.industry", order = "stock_code asc", limit = -1) -> industry_code, industry_name, stock_code, stock_name

cases.user_query: 查询所有板块的代码和名称。
cases.request: r1 = plate.basic_info(limit = 500) -> plate_code, plate_name

cases.user_query: 今天涨幅最高的板块前20名。
cases.request: r1 = plate.quote(order = "pct desc", limit = 20, realtime = 1) -> code, name, tradedate, close, pct, amount, volumn

cases.user_query: 所有板块过去20个交易日累计涨幅前10名。
cases.request: r2 = plate.quote.kd_pct_sum(k = 20, filter = "plate_code in r1.plate_code", order = "value desc", limit = 10, realtime = 0) -> plate_code, plate_name, value as pct_20d

cases.user_query: 所有板块过去20个交易日累计涨幅前10名。
cases.request: r2 = plate.quote.kd_pct_sum(k = 20, filter = "code in r1.plate_code", order = "value desc", limit = 10, realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as pct_20d

cases.user_query: 查询沪深300ETF的基金代码、简称和全称。
cases.request: r1 = fund.basic_info(filter = "name like '%沪深300ETF%'", limit = 10) -> code, name, full_name

cases.user_query: 查询名称包含转债的债券代码和名称。
cases.request: r1 = bond.basic_info(filter = "name like %转债%", limit = 20) -> code, name

cases.user_query: 今天涨幅最高的债券前20名。
cases.request: r1 = bond.quote(order = "pct desc", limit = 20, realtime = 1) -> code, name, tradedate, close, pct, amount, volumn

cases.user_query: 获取机器人板块成分股今日涨跌幅，用于分析上涨家数、领涨和分化。
cases.request: r5 = stock.quote(filter = "stock_code in r4.stock_code and tradedate = -1", order = "pct desc", limit = -1, realtime = 0) -> code, name, tradedate, close, pct, amount

cases.user_query: 比较贵州茅台和五粮液最新的PE、PB估值。
cases.request: r1 = stock.pricevalue(filter = "code in ('600519.SH','000858.SZ')", order = "code asc", limit = 2, realtime = 0) -> code, name, tradedate, pe, pe_ttm, pb, pb_mrq

cases.user_query: 比较宁德时代和比亚迪最新的融资余额与融资净买入。
cases.request: r1 = stock.margin(filter = "code in (300750.SZ, 002594.SZ)", order = "tradedate desc", limit = 2, realtime = 0) -> code, name, tradedate, financing_balance, financing_net_buy

cases.user_query: 查询贵州茅台2024年以来各报告期的营业收入、净利润和ROE。
cases.request: r1 = stock.financial_3_table(filter = "code = 600519.SH and report_period >= 2024-01-01", order = "report_date desc", limit = 8) -> code, name, report_date, report_period, revenue, net_profit, roe

cases.user_query: 查询宁德时代最近一次增发的公告日期、进度和价格。
cases.request: r1 = stock.corporate_action(filter = "code = 300750.SZ and source = add_issue", order = "ann_date desc", limit = 1) -> code, name, ann_date, ai_type, ai_progress, ai_raised_funds, ai_price

cases.user_query: 查询贵州茅台最近披露的前十大股东名称、排名和持股比例。
cases.request: r1 = stock.shareholder(filter = "code = 600519.SH and source = top10", order = "ann_date desc", limit = 10) -> code, name, source, ann_date, holder_name, holder_rank, holder_pct
